items.title: Pipeline Squeeze Keeps Southeast Natural Gas Prices Hot
items.summary: Record-challenging heat and pipeline constraints kept natural gas prices elevated across parts of the Southeast and South Louisiana on Thursday, even as cooler weather pressured markets across much of the rest of the country.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Lose Steam After Bullish Storage Surprise
items.summary: Natural gas futures initially strengthened Thursday after a smaller-than-expected government storage injection reinforced signs that the US inventory cushion is tightening, but the buying lost momentum as the session progressed.

items.title: Natural Gas Prompt Month Forwards Edge Higher as Winter Strip Hits 2026 Low
items.summary: Natural gas forward prices firmed during the Sept. 9–16 trading period as record September heat kept power burn running at summer levels across the South and held storage injections well below seasonal norms.

items.title: ‘A Long Time Coming’ for Ecuador, Colombia’s New LNG Plans
items.summary: Ecuador’s state oil and gas company Petroecuador is seeking interest in an LNG import project as the nation’s government looks to shore up energy security.

items.title: Southeast Natural Gas Premiums Are Rivaling Winter Peaks
items.summary: Southeast spot natural gas prices are carrying premiums to Henry Hub normally seen only in the depths of winter as late season heat drives record September power demand and squeezes pipelines already running near capacity.

items.title: Seasonally Lean Storage Build Supports Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures sustained modest momentum just before noon ET on Thursday as traders digested a bullish government inventory print.

items.title: Bulls, Bears Battle Beneath $3 as Natural Gas Traders Prep for Storage Print
items.summary: Natural gas futures traded indecisively ahead of this morning’s government inventory report even as analysts expected a decidedly bullish headline result.
